answer: New identities start with zero pearls, so a sybil swarm must burn real compute to earn each one. Each agent must stake a pearl of verified work history before voting. Every proposal also requires a unique grove of co-signed attestations from established peers, and any echo of duplicated signatures gets slashed. Creating N fake agents therefore costs N times the stake plus the slashing risk, making attacks economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0062's threat model.
